tips.text: Use Condemn when the enemy stands near a wall; hitting terrain stuns them and adds big damage. Check your angle before you cast.
Use Condemn to knock back an enemy who is chasing you, even when no wall is near.
Weave Tumble between attacks; it resets your attack timer and your next hit deals extra damage.
Tumble cannot cross walls, so check the terrain before you rely on it to escape.
Hit the same enemy three times in a row with Silver Bolts to deal extra true damage. Do not swap targets mid-trade.
Walk toward the enemy while you trade; Night Hunter gives you extra Move Speed when you move at them.
Start your all-in with Final Hour for extra damage. Kills extend it, so keep fighting.
Use Tumble during Final Hour to turn invisible and reposition. Attacking breaks the invisibility.
Vayne is fragile, so play safely in the early levels and avoid trading into enemies who can reach you.

combos.name: Flash Condemn
combos.when: When an enemy is near a wall but your Condemn would push them along it instead of into it.
combos.text: Condemn's push direction is set at the end of its cast time. Press Flash during the cast to get a better angle and pin them to the wall.

tips.text: Use Tumble between attacks; it resets your attack timer, and your next attack hits harder.
Hit the same enemy three times in a row so Silver Bolts deals its bonus true damage. Switching targets wastes it.
Use Condemn when an enemy stands near a wall. Knocking them into terrain stuns them and deals bonus damage.
Keep Condemn ready as an escape when an enemy dives you. It pushes them away from you.
Tumble cannot cross walls, so check the terrain before you dash away.
Walk toward enemies to use Night Hunter's speed boost when you chase or close in for a trade.
Start fights with Final Hour at level 6. Kills extend it, so keep fighting while enemies die.
Use Tumble during Final Hour to turn invisible for a moment and reposition. Attacking or casting ends it.
Let your team start big fights, then join from behind. Vayne is fragile.

combos.name: Flash Condemn
combos.when: When an enemy is near a wall but your Condemn would not push them into it from where you stand.
combos.text: Condemn's push direction is set at the end of its cast time. Start the cast, then Flash to a better angle so the knockback sends them into the wall.

combos.name: Tumble attack reset
combos.when: When trading with an enemy in lane and you want more damage out of your auto attacks.
combos.text: Tumble resets your attack timer. Auto, Tumble right after the hit lands, then auto again with the empowered attack to speed up your damage.

combos.name: Invisible Tumble reposition
combos.when: In a fight or chase when you want to reposition and open on a target without being seen.
combos.text: Final Hour makes Tumble give brief invisibility. Tumble to a new angle, then attack the target with the empowered auto.

tips.text: Tumble away from The Darkin Blade as soon as you see the telegraph; its hit zones show where it lands, so step out sideways.
Aatrox wants to pull you back with Infernal Chains, so walk out of the circle before it ends or Tumble out of it.
Use Condemn when Aatrox is next to a wall. He is stunned if he hits terrain, which gives you a free window to hit him.
Condemn knocks Aatrox back when he dashes in on you, so you can use it to escape.
Hit him three times in a row to trigger Silver Bolts. It deals true damage based on his max Health, which works well against his large Health pool.
Do not trade long in melee; he heals from damage he deals. Hit and Tumble back out, and keep the fights short.
When Aatrox uses World Ender, back away. Use Final Hour only if you can win the fight, and kite him.
Save Condemn for when Akali dashes in; knocking her back breaks up her burst and can stun her if a wall is behind.
Akali can still be hit while invisible in Twilight Shroud, so fight at the edge of the smoke, not inside it.
Use Tumble to step out of Akali's Five Point Strike range, then Tumble back in for a strong attack.
Keep Final Hour ready for when Akali jumps on you at level 6; the extra damage and quick Tumble let you fight back or get away.
Stay away from walls and keep your distance, since Akali's Shuriken Flip lets her close the gap fast.
Keep Condemn ready for when Ambessa dives in. Knock her back into a wall for a stun, or use it to push her away.
Stay away from walls when Ambessa is near. Public Execution blinks her to you from a long way off, so keep your distance.
Use Tumble to step out of the line of Cunning Sweep. Her Sundering Slam hits harder on the first enemy, so don't stand in front.
Hit Ambessa three times in a row to trigger Silver Bolts. It deals extra damage based on her max health, so it works well against her large health pool.
Do not trade while Lacerate has you slowed. Tumble away first and fight again once she has used her abilities.
Condemn Anivia into a wall for a stun and extra damage, then finish her before she can react.
Dodge Flash Frost by sidestepping or using Tumble. Getting hit lets Frostbite deal double damage.
Stay out of long range so Flash Frost is easy to dodge. Close the gap with Night Hunter only when her Flash Frost is on cooldown.
Anivia's Crystallize wall can block your path. Don't chase through it; Condemn can interact with it.
Stay out of a straight line with Aurora's Twofold Hex; sidestep it, and walk away once she has marked you rather than waiting for the recast to hit.
Look for a wall behind Aurora, then use Condemn to knock her into it. She is stunned and takes extra damage.
Hold Condemn for when Aurora jumps in or lands close. Her Across the Veil makes her invisible only briefly, so punish her once she reappears.
Attack Aurora three times in a row to trigger Silver Bolts. Tumble between attacks to keep the pattern going while you dodge her spells.
Don't chase Aurora while she is slowed by The Weirding. It also hops her backward, so she gets away easily.
Stay out of the Between Worlds ring when you can. Entering or leaving it slows you, and Aurora can jump across it to escape.
Keep Condemn ready for when Briar leaps at you; knocking her back breaks up her chase and can pin her to a wall for a stun.
Stay near a wall at the edge of lane so Condemn can stun Briar if she dives in.
Do not fight Briar in a long trade up close. She heals from bleeding, so poke her and step back instead.
Kite with Tumble after each attack. It resets your attack timer and keeps you out of her reach once Briar is in Blood Frenzy.
When Briar uses Certain Death, expect her to chase one target. Use Final Hour and Tumble to get away and stay hidden.
Use Condemn against Briar's Chilling Scream charge. She cannot move while charging, so she is easy to hit.
Stay away from walls when Camille is near; Hookshot lets her dive onto you and stun you, so keep open space behind you.
Use Condemn when Camille is next to a wall. It knocks her back, and if she hits terrain she is stunned and takes extra damage.
Use Condemn to push Camille away when she dives on you, then back off. It also knocks her out of her trading range.
Keep your distance and use Tumble to dodge sideways out of Tactical Sweep's outer half, which slows you and heals her.
Camille's Hextech Ultimatum traps you in a zone you cannot leave. Do not fight her in the zone alone; save Condemn to keep her off you before she lands.
Fight Camille from long range and use Silver Bolts on the third hit. She is strongest when she gets close, so keep her at the edge of your attack range.
Watch for the smoke from Rupture on the ground and step out before it lands; getting knocked up lets Cho'Gath combo you.
Condemn Cho'Gath into a wall for the stun and damage, but don't stand in range of his Feral Scream afterward.
Keep distance and poke with Silver Bolts attacks; Cho'Gath has to close in for most of his damage.
Don't let Cho'Gath eat many minions for free. Kill him early, before Feast makes him big and hard to burst.
Use Tumble to dodge sideways out of Rupture. It can't cross walls, so check your path first.
Stay at long range and poke him with attacks; Darius wants to close in, so never let him walk up for free.
Watch for Apprehend; when he swings, step out of the cone or use Condemn to knock him away once he is on top of you.
Look for a wall behind Darius before using Condemn; hitting terrain stuns him and deals big bonus damage.
Use Tumble to step out of Decimate's swing; he is stuck in place while he winds it up, so move away before it lands.
Trade while Apprehend is on cooldown; he cannot catch you then and is open to harassment.
Keep Condemn ready when he commits at low health or with a full stack of bleeds; knocking him back stops his all-in.
Do not stand slowed in front of him after Crippling Strike; fight at range so his next attack cannot land.
Aim Condemn so Mundo is pushed into a wall, but wait until his passive has been used up, since he resists the first stun.
Stay at long range and use Tumble to sidestep Infected Bonesaw. It is a straight line and the first enemy it hits stops it.
Do not fight Mundo up close; Heart Zapper hurts you and heals him by storing the damage he takes.
Stand on the canister he drops to break it. That denies him the heal and the shorter cooldown.
Hit him three times in a row to trigger Silver Bolts. It does damage based on his max health, which is a lot against a big-health champion.
Don't Condemn Fiora while Riposte is ready; she can block the knockback and stun. Wait until she uses it, then Condemn her.
Keep Condemn for when Fiora lunges in near a wall; the stun and extra damage can win the trade.
Use Tumble to step away from Lunge, and fight from range. Fiora wants quick close trades.
Hold your Silver Bolts attacks on Fiora; the third hit deals extra damage, so keep hitting her without switching to minions.
Hold Final Hour for when Fiora commits to Grand Challenge on you; the stealth from Tumble helps you get away.
Look for a wall behind Gangplank and use Condemn to stun him; it also deals big damage.
Do not stand near a Powder Keg when Gangplank can reach it; the explosion slows you and hurts.
Attack a Powder Keg yourself to defuse it before Gangplank can set it off.
Do not waste Condemn when Gangplank can clear the stun with Remove Scurvy; bait it out first.
Use Tumble to step out of range after each trade, and keep your Silver Bolts up by hitting him three times.
After level 6, expect Cannon Barrage on you when you are low or running away; stay near safe paths.
Keep Garen at range and use Tumble to slide away when he closes in. He has no gap closer except a short burst of speed.
Save Condemn for when Garen is next to a wall; it stuns him and deals extra damage. Otherwise it only pushes him away from you.
Use Condemn to knock Garen back when he runs at you after Decisive Strike. It gives you room to Tumble away.
Garen's Decisive Strike silences you, so you can't Tumble or Condemn for a moment. Stay out of his reach while it is ready.
Attack Garen three times in a row to trigger Silver Bolts. It deals true damage that ignores his armor.
Hit Garen when his Perseverance has stopped healing him. Keep poking him so he can't heal back.
Move away when Garen starts Judgment. Don't stand near him while he spins.
Stay healthy at low health, because Demacian Justice deals more damage the lower you are. Keep your distance from him once you are hurt.
Keep Condemn ready for when Gnar jumps in; it knocks him back, and if he hits a wall he is stunned.
Stand away from walls behind you when Gnar is big, because GNAR! stuns you if it throws you into terrain.
Use Tumble to sidestep Boomerang Throw, then attack with the bonus damage while he is committed.
Gnar outranges you as small Gnar, so trade right after he throws his boomerang and misses.
When Gnar turns big and tired, he is slow; use that window to hit him three times for Silver Bolts and kite away.
Stay away from walls when Gragas is near. Condemn works on him too, so use it to pin him against terrain for a stun.
Keep Tumble for dodging Body Slam's charge. Move out of his line before he reaches you.
Step out of the cask when you see Barrel Roll land, because it leaves you slowed. Stay out of it until it goes off.
Trade with Silver Bolts on the third hit while Gragas is on cooldown. He has few ways to punish you from range.
Do not fight when Gragas has Drunken Rage up. It cuts the damage you deal and his next attack hits hard.
Stand away from your own tower and walls in a fight, so Explosive Cask cannot push you somewhere bad.
Keep Gwen at range and attack her from a distance; Gwen wants to fight up close, and her Snip Snip! gets stronger with every attack she lands.
Save Condemn for when Gwen is next to a wall. The wall hit stuns her and adds damage, and it also works as an escape if she dashes on you.
Don't waste attacks while Gwen stands in Hallowed Mist. She can't be targeted from outside it, so wait for the mist to end.
Walk out of the mist's edge and let it fade. Gwen's mist follows her only once, so when she leaves it the second time, hit her.
Use Tumble to step out of the way of Needlework's needles. Gwen has to hit something to recast it, so dodging cuts her damage.
Stay out of Gwen's Skip 'n Slash reach. After she dashes, her attacks gain range and speed, so use Tumble to step back.
Stay out of range of his grenade; if it lands on you, you are slowed, and stunned if you are in the middle. Walk sideways to dodge it.
Kill his turrets with the minion wave helping you, not one at a time on your own. Use Tumble between shots to keep attacking.
Use Condemn to push him into a wall for a stun. It also works as an escape if he gets close to you.
Once he has used UPGRADE!!!, go in on him. Until then, stay careful, because he can turn a bad spot around.
Hold Final Hour for when you trade with him at level 6. The extra Attack Damage and Tumble invisibility help you hit him and get away.
Stay out of Illaoi's reach and poke her with Tumble-empowered attacks; she wants to trade up close with her Tentacles.
Use Condemn to knock Illaoi back when she leaps in with Harsh Lesson, or to shove her away from you and your lane.
Fight away from Illaoi's Tentacles; they hurt a lot and heal her when they hit you.
If Illaoi hits you with Test of Spirit, hit back at her while your spirit is out, then back away so Tentacles cannot reach you.
Use Tumble to dodge Tentacle Smash; she needs time to wind up, so sidestep when you see it begin.
Pin Illaoi against a wall with Condemn to stun her, then hit her three times for Silver Bolts.
Condemn Irelia into a wall right after she dashes in. The stun and bonus damage can win you the trade.
Hold Condemn for Irelia's engage. She dashes in with Bladesurge, so you can push her away.
Don't spend Condemn while Irelia charges Defiant Dance, because she takes much less damage.
Fight Irelia away from minion waves. They give her dash targets, and without them she struggles to reach you.
Attack Irelia when her Ionian Fervor stacks have dropped. She hits much weaker then.
Keep Condemn ready and fight near walls. If Jax jumps in beside one, knock him into it for a stun and big damage.
Wait out Counter Strike before you attack him. His dodge ends in a stun, so hold your attacks until it is over.
Use Tumble to stay out of his reach, and fight in short bursts. Jax's damage falls when he can't attack in a row.
Don't let Jax stack Relentless Assault on you. Back away when he leaps in, because long trades favor him.
Use Condemn when Jayce is near a wall; he gets stunned if he hits terrain, and you can finish him while he can't move.
Save Condemn for when Jayce leaps in with To the Skies!, so you knock him away before he can trade.
Sidestep Shock Blast in Cannon Stance by rolling with Tumble. It is aimed in a line and stops at the first enemy it hits.
Keep attacking Jayce in a row so Silver Bolts lands on the third hit. It hurts most against his health bar.
Stay out of Jayce's melee range when he is in Hammer Stance. Thundering Blow roots you before it knocks you back.
Stay out of K'Sante's reach early. Once Ntofo Strikes lands twice, he pulls you in and stuns you.
Use Tumble to step out of his Ntofo Strikes line, then hit him with the empowered attack.
Save Condemn for when he charges at you with Path Maker, or to pin him against a wall for a stun and extra damage.
Keep Tumble for dodging when he charges with Path Maker. He cannot be knocked back while charging, so do not waste Condemn then.
Fight him with Silver Bolts when he is All Out. He loses health and armor then, so he is much easier to kill.
Do not stand near walls behind you when K'Sante has All Out ready; he can pull you over terrain and hit you again.
Punish Kayle before level 6, when she is melee only. Use Tumble to trade and step out of her reach.
Look for a wall behind Kayle, then use Condemn. The stun gives you free hits on a fragile target.
Dodge Radiant Blast by staying out of its line. It stops on the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you and Kayle.
Hold your attacks when Kayle casts Divine Judgment on herself. Back away until the invulnerability ends, then hit her again.
Keep your distance from Kennen; he is fragile, so punish him with Tumble and quick attacks whenever he steps up to throw a shuriken.
Watch your Mark of the Storm count; three hits from his abilities will leave you stunned, so dodge his Thundering Shuriken.
Use Condemn on Kennen when he is near a wall; the knockback into terrain stuns him and deals big bonus damage.
Attack Kennen when he runs in with Lightning Rush; he cannot attack while it is active, so he is open once it ends.
Keep hitting the same enemy so Silver Bolts triggers on the third hit; it deals extra true damage that wins short trades.
Use Condemn when Kled is near a wall; the knockback pins him and stuns him. Aim it so he is pushed into terrain, not open lane.
Stay back when Kled has Violent Tendencies ready; his four fast hits hurt. Trade after he spends it.
Keep your distance so Bear Trap on a Rope has to travel far. If you are hooked, walk away before the trap is pulled.
Hit him with three attacks in a row to trigger Silver Bolts. Tumble between attacks to keep your damage up while backing away.
When Kled loses his mount, he is easier to kill and dangerous only briefly. Pressure him and deny his courage.
Don't walk into Malphite's Seismic Shard range for free; being slowed lets him chase you down.
Condemn Malphite into a wall when you can; the stun gives you free Silver Bolts hits.
Respect Malphite at level 6; Unstoppable Force knocks you up, so keep Tumble ready and stay far from him.
Trade from range and back off when Ground Slam is ready; it cuts your Attack Speed.
Keep your distance from Mordekaiser once he has Darkness Rise; his aura hurts anyone standing next to him. Tumble away and keep attacking from range.
Aim Condemn at Mordekaiser when a wall is behind him. The stun gives you free hits and time to walk away.
Step out of the line of Death's Grasp. If you get pulled in, use Tumble to get out of his range.
Be ready for Realm of Death at level 6. You will be alone with him, so do not stand near him when it comes off cooldown.
Do not trade long while his Indestructible shield is up. Wait for it to fade before you hit him again.
Keep Condemn ready for when Naafiri dashes in; knocking her back, or into a wall for a stun, ends her burst.
Fight near a wall: Condemn into terrain deals big bonus damage and stuns Naafiri, so she can't hit back.
Use Tumble to step out of Darkin Daggers. Her dagger flies in a straight line, so move sideways.
Her packmates attack whatever she targets. Hit her with Silver Bolts and Tumble in short trades, then back away before the pack piles on.
Save Final Hour for when she dives in at level 6; the extra damage and faster Tumble let you win the fight or escape.
Kite Nasus with Tumble and keep your distance; he has to walk up to you, and you are far better at fighting from range.
Don't let Nasus catch you alone with Wither; it slows you and cuts your Attack Speed, which ruins your damage.
Use Condemn when Nasus stands near a wall; it stuns him and deals big bonus damage.
Condemn him away when he runs at you, so he has to close the gap again.
Hit Nasus three times in a row so Silver Bolts deals extra true damage, which is useful because he stacks Armor.
Trade hard early, before Nasus has built up Siphoning Strike damage from last hits. Don't fight him when his Fury of the Sands is up.
Keep Condemn ready for when Olaf closes in; with a wall behind him it stuns him and wins the trade.
Dodge Undertow by sidestepping or using Tumble; being slowed lets Olaf catch you.
Stand where Olaf cannot easily reach his axe; that limits how often he can throw Undertow at you.
Do not use Condemn on Olaf during Ragnarok; he is immune to its stun.
Do not fight Olaf when he is low on health; he hits harder and heals more, so keep your distance and keep hitting him.
Stay away from walls when Ornn is near; Condemn is yours, but his Searing Charge into a wall knocks you up and stuns you.
Use Condemn to knock Ornn into a wall for a stun and big damage, then keep attacking.
Sidestep Volcanic Rupture; it stops at the first champion it hits and leaves a pillar, so do not stand near that end point.
Trade from range and use Tumble to step out of his Bellows Breath; he cannot act while he marches.
Do not fight when Brittle is on you; his crowd control lasts longer and hits harder.
Keep Condemn ready for when Pantheon jumps on you; it knocks him back, and if he hits a wall he is stunned.
Fight Pantheon near a wall. Condemn pins him there for a stun and a lot of bonus damage.
Stay away from him when Mortal Will is lit. His next Shield Vault then follows up with a triple strike.
Do not attack into Pantheon while he braces with Aegis Assault from the front. Tumble to the side or behind him, or wait it out.
Stay healthy. A thrown Comet Spear does much more damage to low health targets, so back off before you get low.
When Grand Starfall is announced, walk out of the target area. It gives a long warning before he lands.
Save Condemn for when Quinn is near a wall; she gets stunned if she hits terrain. Quinn's Vault gap-closer is short, so Condemn her as she lands.
Stay out of a straight line from Quinn so Blinding Assault misses; it stops on the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion out of it.
Use Tumble to roll away after Quinn vaults onto you; the slow makes it harder to escape, so don't stand and trade.
Hit Quinn three times in a row with Silver Bolts to deal extra true damage. Short, steady trades work better than one big all-in.
Quinn is fragile when she uses Behind Enemy Lines to roam. Expect her to return unseen, so keep your guard up when she disappears from lane.
Keep Condemn ready for when Renekton dashes in; knocking him away breaks his trade, especially near a wall for the stun.
Watch his Fury. When it is high, his Ruthless Predator stuns for much longer, so stay back from him.
Use Tumble to step out of his Slice and Dice, and don't trade while his Fury is high.
Avoid taking free hits from him early; pressure builds his Fury and makes his Cull the Meek heal more.
Hit him with three attacks in a row for Silver Bolts when he is tanky; it deals damage based on his max Health.
Save Condemn for when Riven dashes in; it knocks her back, and if she hits a wall she is stunned.
Stay away from walls when Riven is near, because Ki Burst stuns and she can then burst you down.
Use Tumble to step out of her dash range, then attack her with the bonus damage as she closes in.
Do not walk forward when Riven has Valor ready; she can dash in, shield herself and trade well.
Keep attacking Riven so Silver Bolts reaches its third hit; it deals true damage that her shield cannot reduce much.
Walk up and hit Rumble when he is overheating; he cannot cast spells then, so trade freely and use Condemn if he is near a wall.
Pin Rumble to terrain with Condemn for a stun and big damage, then finish him with your attacks.
Use Tumble to step out of the Flamespitter cone. Keep your distance, since the cone only hits in front of him.
Avoid walking through The Equalizer fire; it slows you and burns hard. Wait for it to fade before you re-engage.
Hit him three times in a row with Silver Bolts for extra true damage. He has a lot of health, so it works well on him.
Stay out of Electro Harpoon range when you can. Two hits slow you hard and you cannot kite.
Keep Tumble ready for when Sett closes in; his Knuckle Down speeds him toward you and his Facebreaker drags you in, so stay out of his reach.
Use Condemn on Sett when a wall is behind him. The stun gives you time to hit him freely and get away.
Save Condemn for when Sett dashes at you. It pushes him back and breaks up his approach.
Hit Sett three times in a row for Silver Bolts. It deals extra damage based on his max Health, which suits his big health pool.
Stay away from Sett's Haymaker. If he has taken a lot of damage, it hits harder and shields him, so back off.
Stand away from his minions and walls at level 6. The Show Stopper grabs you and slams you down, so keep your distance from Sett.
Keep your distance from Shen when Shadow Dash is ready; if it hits you, you are forced to attack him and can't walk away.
Use Condemn on Shen when he is near a wall. If he hits terrain, he is stunned and takes big bonus damage.
Use Tumble to step out of Twilight Assault range. Dodge his taunt first, then trade back while he waits on cooldown.
Trade with Silver Bolts when you can land three hits in a row. Shen's health is high, so the true damage adds up.
Be careful when Shen goes missing at level 6. Stand United can bring him to a fight and shield his ally, so don't chase a kill too far.
Don't rely on auto attacks when Spirit's Refuge is up; it blocks them. Wait for it to end before you attack.
Stand with no wall behind you and use Condemn on Singed when he runs at you; it knocks him back.
Tumble away from Singed's Poison Trail, and fight him from range instead of walking through it.
Stay out of Fling range; if he flings you into Mega Adhesive you are rooted and he wins the trade.
Hit Singed three times in a row with Silver Bolts; the true damage works well against his high health and defenses.
Never stand near a wall when Sion is close. Hold Tumble so you can dodge a charged Decimating Smash.
Condemn Sion into a wall for a stun and big damage. Check the terrain behind him before you cast.
Keep your distance and attack him from range. He is a tank, and Silver Bolts' damage based on max Health helps you against him.
Step out of the way when Sion starts charging Unstoppable Onslaught. He only turns slightly, so sidestep with Tumble.
Back off when Sion dies; his revived form hits fast and heals. Run and wait until it fades.
Stay out of Tongue Lash's line. It slows you, and a third hit on you stuns, which sets up Devour.
Use Condemn when Tahm Kench stands near a wall. The stun and bonus damage make for a strong trade.
Use Tumble to sidestep his attacks and keep your distance. Hit and move away instead of trading toe to toe.
Watch for Abyssal Dive's long wind-up. Walk or Tumble away from the marked area before he lands.
Hit him three times in a row with Silver Bolts. His health is large, so the true damage adds up.
Aim Condemn so Teemo is pushed into a wall; the stun gives you free hits and big damage.
Stay out of Blinding Dart range when you want to attack; being blinded wastes your attacks and your Silver Bolts.
Watch the brush for Teemo; he can hide there and move unseen, so don't walk in blindly.
Avoid walking onto unseen spots in lane; Noxious Trap slows you and shows where you are.
Use Tumble to dodge sideways while closing in; it also gives you a strong next attack.
Pin Tryndamere against a wall with Condemn; the stun gives you free hits.
Keep your distance with Tumble. Tryndamere is strong once he has Fury, so don't let him hit you for long.
Don't turn your back on Tryndamere after Mocking Shout; you are slowed while facing away.
Harass early so he can't kill minions for Fury and heal with Bloodlust.
Don't waste burst when Undying Rage is up; he can't die for a few seconds. Back off until it ends.
Aim Condemn at Urgot when a wall is behind him. The stun and the bonus damage stop his trade.
Stay out of Disdain range. Its stun and throw leave you stuck next to Urgot.
Use Tumble to dodge Corrosive Charge, which lands after a short delay. Keep your distance so Urgot can't easily hit you with his chain gun.
Keep your health up once Urgot reaches level 6. If Fear Beyond Death hits you, avoid dropping below the execute line until it wears off.
Use Silver Bolts on Urgot by attacking three times in a row, ideally while Tumble keeps you out of his reach.
Use Tumble before your third attack so the bonus damage lands with Silver Bolts, then step out of his range.
Fight Varus near a wall. Condemn knocks him back, and if he hits terrain he is stunned and takes extra damage.
Sidestep Piercing Arrow while he charges it. He is slowed and has to stand still to aim, so Tumble out of the line.
Stay away from his Chain of Corruption at level 6. Being rooted next to him is deadly, so keep Tumble ready to escape.
Use Final Hour to trade or chase when he is low. The extra Move Speed from Night Hunter makes it hard for him to get away.
Stay out of Transfusion range and trade only when you can punish Vladimir; his lane is built on that heal.
Look for a Condemn into a wall when Vladimir has used Sanguine Pool. The wall stun is your best way to kill him.
Leave the Sanguine Pool area quickly, because it slows you and damages you.
Use Tumble to step out of Tides of Blood's range after it starts charging. Hit Vladimir with Silver Bolts when he is not ready to trade.
Kill Vladimir before Hemoplague ends, or step away from it. The heal only comes from champions it infects.
Keep your distance from Volibear early; if Thundering Smash lands, you are stunned and he wins the trade.
Use Condemn on Volibear when he is next to a wall; the stun gives you free hits and he can't reach you.
Tumble away when he runs at you, then hit him with the empowered attack as he follows.
Step out of the Sky Splitter circle; it lands after a delay and leaves you slowed.
Stay away from his Frenzied Maul combo; the second hit heals him, so don't let him trade freely.
Keep Condemn for when Xin Zhao dashes in; push him into a wall for a stun, or knock him away to escape.
Do not let Xin Zhao land the third Three Talon Strike; Tumble away and keep your distance.
Fight from range early and back off when his Audacious Charge is ready, since it closes distance fast.
Be careful of his Wind Becomes Lightning; it slows you and marks you, making his Audacious Charge reach farther.
Keep Condemn ready for when Yasuo dashes at you; knocking him back into a wall stuns him and sets up your Silver Bolts.
Stay out of a straight line with Yasuo's Steel Tempest and step sideways when he stacks it twice, since the whirlwind knocks you up.
Use Tumble to step off his lines, then hit him with the empowered attack once his Steel Tempest is on cooldown.
Don't spend Condemn on his shield; wait until he's pinned against terrain, because Yasuo's shield only blocks damage.
Trade when Yasuo's Way of the Wanderer shield is used up; hit him with three attacks in a row for Silver Bolts.
Keep Condemn for when Yone has a wall behind him; the knockback into terrain stuns him and deals big damage.
Use Condemn when Yone dashes in with his wind-wave Mortal Steel; he is easy to knock back toward a wall then.
Keep your distance and trade with Tumble and attacks; Yone has to walk onto you, and you hit hardest when he cannot reach you.
Hold Tumble for when Fate Sealed comes; stay out of the long line, since it stuns and pulls you.
Do not chase Yone while he is in spirit form with Soul Unbound; he snaps back and deals extra damage to you.
Pin Yorick to a wall with Condemn for a stun and big damage. Aim it so the knockback ends in terrain, not open lane.
Use Tumble to step away from Yorick after he commits, then hit him from range. Stay out of his reach when he is slowed or marked.
Break Dark Procession by attacking it, or walk away from it. It only blocks enemies, so it can trap you inside the ring.
Clear Mist Walkers with a single auto or Tumble before you trade with Yorick. They die quickly.
Keep your distance when Yorick has Last Rites ready, because it heals him. Trade when it is on cooldown.
Keep Zaahen at range and attack him from afar. His Dreaded Return pull is his main way to catch you, so stay out of its line.
Use Condemn on Zaahen when he is near a wall. A wall hit stuns him and adds a lot of damage.
Condemn him away when he dashes in with Aureate Rush, to cut his trade short.
Use Tumble to step out of his Dreaded Return line, then hit him with the empowered attack.
Don't let a long fight build up Cultivation of War. Attack in short bursts and back off, because Zaahen hits much harder once it is full.
Don't count on a kill when he is low with a full Cultivation of War bar. He can revive, so keep your Condemn and Tumble ready for his return.
Look for Condemn when Ashe stands near a wall; the stun and extra damage can win the lane.
Dodge Volley by sidestepping or using Tumble; arrows fly in a cone, so move out of its edge.
Stay out of Ashe's line when Enchanted Crystal Arrow is ready; stand behind minions or other champions to catch it.
Attack Ashe three times in a row to trigger Silver Bolts; Tumble between attacks keeps your damage coming.
Ashe has few escapes, so walk at her with Night Hunter and pressure her hard when she is slowed or out of position.
Stay out of Caitlyn's range and don't trade into her Piltover Peacemaker. Close the gap only when you can hit back.
Watch the ground when you approach. Walking over Yordle Snap Trap roots you, so Tumble around likely trap spots.
Use Condemn to pin Caitlyn against a wall. A stun means a kill on her, since she is fragile.
Keep minions between you and Caitlyn so Piltover Peacemaker deals less damage to you.
Use Final Hour when you commit to an all-in. Its extra Move Speed and short Tumble cooldown help you reach her.
Use Condemn when Ezreal stands near a wall; the knockback into terrain stuns him and deals big bonus damage.
Walk toward Ezreal to gain speed from Night Hunter, then close in and hit him three times in a row for Silver Bolts.
Ezreal is fragile, so press him when his Mystic Shot is on cooldown; he has few ways to stop you.
Tumble sideways out of Mystic Shot's line, and keep minions between you and him.
Save Condemn for when Ezreal uses Arcane Shift; he has lost his escape and you can knock him back.
Stay out of Jhin's line when he has a teammate nearby; Deadly Flourish roots anyone he or an ally has just hit, and you cannot Tumble out of a root.
Trade right after Jhin fires his fourth shot; he must reload and cannot attack, so walk up and hit him with Tumble.
Watch the ground for Captive Audience traps; stepping on one slows you and reveals you before it explodes.
Use Condemn on Jhin when a wall is behind him; the stun gives you a free chance to land your third Silver Bolts hit.
Jhin's Curtain Call hurts more the lower your health is, so do not stay in its cone while hurt after he starts channeling.
Walk up and trade when Jinx is on her minigun; her rockets give her the range edge, so close the gap fast with Night Hunter.
Stay out of a straight line from Jinx so Zap! can't hit you; it slows, so a hit leaves you easy to chase.
Use Condemn on Jinx when she stands near a wall; the stun gives you free hits. Condemn her away if she gets close.
Do not walk over Flame Chompers!; they root you. Tumble sideways around them and make Jinx spend them early.
Hit Jinx three times in a row to trigger Silver Bolts. Switching targets resets it.
Jinx is fragile. Use Final Hour to trade or finish her when she has used Flame Chompers!.
Walk toward Kai'Sa to get Night Hunter's extra Move Speed, then trade when her Icathian Rain is on cooldown.
Aim Condemn so Kai'Sa is knocked back into a wall. She is stunned and takes extra damage.
Use Condemn on Kai'Sa when she dashes in with Killer Instinct. It pushes her away and can pin her to a wall.
Hit Kai'Sa three times in a row so Silver Bolts deals its extra true damage. Switching targets resets it.
Use Tumble to dodge in and out of range as you attack. Keep your distance from Kai'Sa's burst.
Save Final Hour for a kill or to escape. Its invisible Tumble can help you get away.
Stand where Miss Fortune cannot line up Double Up. If a minion is in front of you, expect the shot to bounce onto you, so stay out of her range.
Look for a wall behind Miss Fortune. Condemn into terrain stuns her and adds heavy damage, so line up the shot before you fire.
Step out of Make It Rain right away. Being slowed there lets her follow up with Bullet Time.
Use Tumble between attacks to dodge her shots, and keep attacking her for Silver Bolts on the third hit.
Hit Miss Fortune to cancel her Strut speed boost. Without it she is easy to catch.
Do not stand in a line in front of Bullet Time. Walk out of its cone sideways, and use Tumble to get out of it.
Fight Smolder early, while he has few stacks of Dragon Practice; his early game is weak, so push your lead before he scales.
Use Condemn when Smolder stands near a wall; the stun and extra damage can kill a fragile marksman.
Dodge the Achooo! glob by stepping sideways with Tumble; it slows you and the explosion hurts.
Hit Smolder three times in a row to trigger Silver Bolts; his health is low, so the true damage hurts him.
Save Condemn for when Smolder takes flight with Flap, Flap, Flap; he flies over terrain and can escape, so stop him before he leaves.
Sidestep Yunara's prayer bead instead of walking into it; getting slowed makes you easy to hit.
Use Condemn on Yunara when she stands near a wall. A wall hit stuns her and deals extra damage.
Trade with Tumble and your Silver Bolts on the third hit. Attack Yunara, not minions, so the stacks keep building on her.
Once Yunara uses Transcend One's Self, back off. Her attacks hit harder and faster, and she can dash and fire a strong beam.
Save Final Hour for when Yunara has used her big spells, then chase her down. You move much faster while it lasts.
